claude_proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_multi_spawned_creature
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current magic-item summon family can create one companion, but this collection includes a variant that can produce two creatures from one item activation and lets the user choose one or both simultaneously.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Golden Lions (Rare). These gold statuettes of lions are always created in pairs. You can use one figurine or both simultaneously. Each can become a Lion for up to 1 hour."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: spawned_creature_bound_rider_bundle
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Several variants attach additional mechanics to the summoned creature's ongoing state, riding state, or temporary anatomy. Those riders are not representable as today's plain spawned-creature payload plus passive/activation parts.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "While you ride the goat, any Hostile creature that starts its turn within a 30-foot Emanation originating from the goat must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition ..." and "While in raven form, the figurine grants you the ability to cast Animal Messenger on it."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: active_duration_charge_drain
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Goat of Traveling spends charges per hour while in creature form. Current activation resources are paid on activation and reset later; they cannot drain continuously during an active summoned-creature duration.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "It has 24 charges, and each hour or portion thereof it spends in goat form costs 1 charge."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: spawned_creature_rebellion_misfire
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Obsidian Steed introduces a probabilistic rebellious state that changes command behavior and can trigger a mount-specific transport mishap. That is a summon-state machine, not a single existing effect atom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "The figurine has a 10 percent chance each time you use it to ignore your orders ... If you mount the nightmare while it is ignoring your orders, you and the nightmare are instantly transported to a random location on the plane of Hades, where the nightmare reverts to figurine form."
